title: Colour grading
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Grading fragments describe the finished look. Choose one per shot.

entries.label: Teal and orange blockbuster
entries.prompt: The colour grade is a teal and orange blockbuster look, with warm amber skin tones against cool teal shadows and rich contrast.
entries.notes: Classic big-budget action palette; pairs well with hard or rim light.

entries.label: Kodak 2383 print film
entries.prompt: The image has the look of a Kodak 2383 print film grade, with gently rolled-off highlights, deep rich blacks, slightly warm mids and fine organic grain.
entries.notes: Soft, filmic and forgiving; a safe cinematic default.

entries.label: Bleach bypass
entries.prompt: The grade is bleach bypass, desaturated and gritty with crushed contrast, silvery highlights and a harsh metallic texture.
entries.notes: High contrast, low saturation; avoid for food or beauty.

entries.label: Golden hour warm
entries.prompt: The grade is warm golden hour, with honeyed highlights, soft amber glow and gently lifted shadows.
entries.notes: Pairs with low sun and backlight.

entries.label: Noir monochrome
entries.prompt: The footage is black and white noir, with deep inky blacks, bright specular highlights and strong contrast.
entries.notes: True monochrome; add hard side light for best results.

entries.label: Clean commercial
entries.prompt: The grade is clean and bright, with accurate colour, crisp whites, neutral skin tones and gentle contrast.
entries.notes: Neutral, high-key; the default for product work.

entries.label: Soft pastel
entries.prompt: The grade is soft pastel, with milky lifted blacks, muted candy tones and a dreamy low-contrast finish.
entries.notes: Low contrast; avoid in dark scenes.

entries.label: Night neon
entries.prompt: The grade is a night neon look, with saturated magenta and cyan highlights, glossy reflections and deep blue-black shadows.
entries.notes: Pairs with wet streets and practical light.

entries.label: Cold desaturated thriller
entries.prompt: The grade is cold and slightly desaturated, with steel blue shadows, pale skin tones and restrained contrast.
entries.notes: Good for dread; keep faces readable.

entries.label: Natural neutral
entries.prompt: The grade is natural and true to life, with balanced exposure, honest colour and no heavy stylisation.
